title: AWS CodePipeline — Build, Test, and Deploy Safely

chapters.title: A deployment must use the exact artifact that passed the exact tests
Build, verify, test, and review the release decision without a pipeline
Put CodeBuild commands and report rules in buildspec dot yml
Create the artifact and a manifest with revision and digest
Publish the app, manifest, and test file without flattening paths
Prove good, failed, empty, rejected, and changed-artifact decisions
Parsed YAML and a gate model cannot prove a service execution
You now have a safe gate design without a fake deployment claim
